caveats: Five-second samples cannot identify accepted/rejected critical gaps or saturation capacity.
An occupied point can clear before a following5s merge; not simultaneous body overlap.
Frame means and vehicle-sample medians differ; spatial samples are not paired accelerations.
Known ramp-origin targets are only those observed since the cached range began.
Seed47 paired-frame window ends3145.1, not3150; counts are not450s MER balances.
Crossing lane is ambiguous if a vehicle changes lanes in the5s interval.
Realized crossing flow is not an inferred saturation capacity.
